rowPolicy.staleRowRule: If a source cannot be re-verified, downgrade the row note/status before promoting any new claim.

returnBrief.title: Return Brief
returnBrief.checkFirst: Start with Satoshi API discovery, SATLAB Experiment 001, and the x402 Ecosystem directory to see the difference between live owned endpoints, paid-call evidence, and ecosystem listings.
returnBrief.whyReturn: Rows should change as new paid endpoints, facilitator metadata, platform docs, or captured payment proofs appear. The value is the delta over time, not a one-time list.
returnBrief.nextSafeAction: Use new research as row candidates, then promote only the rows backed by public HTTPS sources and conservative proof-status labels.
returnBrief.caveat: Do not use the ledger as revenue proof, partnership proof, or endorsement proof unless a cited source supports that exact statement.
